name: Thuggish Brawler (Combat)
body:
You are lumbering and imprecise but powerful fighter, able to use your strength and bulk to the best advantage in brawls.

Prerequisite(s): Str 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack

Benefit(s): When using the Power Attack feat, you may also choose to reduce your mobility in order to take advantage of combat opportunities.

Every 10 feet of your base movement rate you sacrifice grants you a +2 bonus on damage rolls and your Combat Maneuver Bonus. The reduction to your speed lasts until your next turn begins. You cannot reduce your speed to 0 feet using this ability.

Special: When using this feat, you may not make a 5 foot-step.
